JOURNAL

Why “Yu Stellar”

2026.09.16

Whenever someone asks about the name, I find the most honest answer is actually simple: stars don't speak, but they're always there — telling you, quietly and stubbornly, through light and position alone, that they're still shining. That's the kind of song I want to write, too.

"語" (yǔ) means voice, or speech — the sentence you've already rehearsed in your head many times but haven't said out loud yet. So many feelings that can't be spoken by day suddenly find their shape at night — turning into a melody, or the rough draft of a lyric. What Yu Stellar wants to do is say those things again, in sound, the things there wasn't time to finish saying in daylight.

So there's no grand statement hiding in this name — just two quiet words: star, and voice. If you've ever lain in the dark staring at the ceiling, thinking about something you never got to say, that's probably the reason Yu Stellar exists.
